exportTo.ctaTitle: Ready to import from Japan to {country}?
exportTo.ctaSubtitle: Tell us the vehicle you're looking for and your timeline. We'll confirm feasibility, total cost and the next steps within one business day.

q1.q: Can I import any used Japanese car to {country}?
q1.a: Most used Japanese vehicles can be exported to {country}, but local import rules apply — typically an age limit, an inspection or compliance test, and import duty + VAT. We confirm the latest rules for your specific model and year before bidding so there are no surprises at the destination port.

q2.q: How long does shipping from Japan to {country} take?
q2.a: Ocean transit from Yokohama or Nagoya to {country} is typically 4–6 weeks for RoRo or container vessels, depending on routing and port congestion. We add 1–2 weeks for inland transport, export deregistration and booking. Budget about 6–8 weeks total from payment to arrival.

q3.q: What is the total landed cost of importing from Japan?
q3.a: Total landed cost = vehicle price + ClickCar service fee + Japan inland transport + ocean freight + marine insurance + your country's import duty + VAT/GST + port handling + local compliance work. We give you a fixed-JPY written quote before bidding, so the only variable is your local duty/VAT which is paid at arrival.

q4.q: Do I need to be present in Japan to buy?
q4.a: No — ClickCar handles the entire process remotely. You tell us your requirements, we source vehicles, inspect them at our Saitama yard, attend the auction on your behalf and ship the vehicle to {country}. You only need to be available by email/WhatsApp for approvals and sign-off at the destination port.

q5.a: We accept JPY bank wire transfer (T/T) to ClickCar's business account in Saitama. We never request payment to a personal account or in a currency other than JPY. Funds are released to the auction house only after a successful bid is confirmed; if the bid is lost, your money is fully refundable minus documented administrative costs.

q6.q: What documents come with the vehicle?
q6.a: You receive the original Japanese registration certificate (車検証), export cancellation certificate (輸出抹消証明書), original auction sheet with inspector notes, commercial invoice, bill of lading, and ClickCar's condition report with photographs. These are sent by EMS alongside the vessel tracking information.

q1.q: Can an overseas buyer bid directly at Japanese auctions?
q1.a: Most Japanese dealer auctions are restricted to approved members. ClickCar acts as the Japan-based intermediary and only places a bid after receiving your vehicle-specific authorization.

q2.q: Does setting a maximum bid guarantee a purchase?
q2.a: No. Another bidder may exceed your limit, or the seller may set a reserve that is not reached. We will not exceed the maximum you approved.

q3.q: Can you guarantee the condition from an auction sheet?
q3.a: An auction sheet is an important condition reference, not a full mechanical warranty. We explain its contents and can discuss additional inspection options when available.

q4.q: What happens after a successful bid?
q4.a: We confirm the purchase result and payment schedule, then coordinate vehicle collection, any requested preparation, export documents and shipping.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about our services

q1.q: Can overseas buyers buy from Japanese dealer auctions?
q1.a: Most Japanese dealer auctions are limited to registered members. ClickCar can search eligible auction listings and place a bid only after you approve the specific vehicle and maximum bid amount.

q2.q: How do I import a used car from Japan?
q2.a: Share your preferred model, budget and destination country. We then confirm a stock or auction vehicle, review available condition information, prepare a quote, receive payment, and coordinate export documents and shipping.

q3.a: Ocean freight transit times vary by destination: Southeast Asia 2-3 weeks, Middle East 3-4 weeks, Africa 4-6 weeks, Europe 5-8 weeks, South America 6-8 weeks. Export documentation typically takes 1-2 weeks.

q4.q: What payment methods do you accept?
q4.a: We accept bank wire transfer (T/T), credit card (Visa/Mastercard), and PayPal. All transactions are settled in Japanese Yen.

q5.a: We provide detailed condition reports for all vehicles. Limited warranty may be available for select vehicles upon negotiation. Please consult our advisors for details.

q6.q: Can I specify the destination port?
q6.a: Yes. We support ocean freight to major ports worldwide. Specify your destination port when making an inquiry.

q7.a: Services include pre-purchase evaluation, pre-delivery inspection, basic servicing and repairs, documentation assistance. Specific services can be customized to your needs.

q8.q: What if I'm not satisfied with the vehicle?
q8.a: We provide detailed condition reports and photos before delivery. If there are discrepancies with the description, please contact us promptly for resolution.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: ClickCar（クリックカー） takes your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

use.title: Information Usage

protect.title: Data Security

service.title: Service Description
service.content: ClickCar（クリックカー） provides Japanese used vehicle display, sales brokerage, and global export services. All vehicle information is subject to actual condition; images and descriptions on the website are for reference only.

pricing.title: Pricing & Payment
pricing.content: All prices are displayed in Japanese Yen (JPY). Final prices may vary due to vehicle preparation, transport costs, and export processing fees. Payment methods include bank wire transfer and credit cards, as confirmed per order.

purchase.title: Purchase Process
purchase.content: The purchase process includes: inquiry → quote confirmation → contract & payment → vehicle preparation → export shipping → delivery. Deposits may be non-refundable if cancellation is due to the buyer.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.content: We arrange ocean freight shipping from Japan to your designated port. Transit time varies by destination, typically 2-8 weeks. Shipping risks are governed by international cargo transport terms.

warranty.title: Disclaimer
warranty.content: Used vehicles are delivered as-is. We provide no additional warranty unless explicitly stated in the sales contract. We strive for accuracy in vehicle descriptions but do not guarantee absolute condition.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Updated terms will be posted on the website. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
